screen_type: post-validation candidate novelty and adversarial screen
scope: Frozen Open entries of group order at most 36, with exact candidate focus SDS(9,8,1,[3,3])

findings.conclusion: The campaign is viable. The order-9 nonexistence result is novelty-supported, not proven novel.

sources.role: canonical repository, history, branches, tags, issues, and forks
repository metadata checked on screen date
follow-up constructions and alternate parameter families
publication identity and bibliographic cross-check for follow-up

adversarial_checks.objection: The global-sign normalization could have omitted valid vectors of sum -4.
adversarial_checks.test: A separate ternary-product traversal validated all 504 support-8 vectors with absolute coefficient sum 4.

adversarial_checks.objection: The group might have been interpreted as cyclic order 9.
adversarial_checks.test: Repository code passes [3,3] to Sage AdditiveAbelianGroup, and the implementation uses the componentwise product C3 x C3. The cyclic [9] entry was run separately.

adversarial_checks.objection: The search and validator may share one indexing bug.
adversarial_checks.test: Tuple/dictionary and mixed-radix validators were independently implemented; known cyclic and noncyclic repository witnesses pass both, while an invalid vector fails both.

caveat: Search-engine and citation screening cannot prove universal absence of prior work; no public novelty claim is made.
